source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: After this model shoots in [your Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), each enemy unit hit by an attack from its **[[INDIRECT FIRE]](vsdata:weapon-ability/indirect-fire)** weapons takes a [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock). Whenever one of those attacks **destroys** an enemy model with [Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise), that model's Deadly Demise causes mortal wounds on a 5+ instead of only on a 6.

effects.appliesTo: each enemy unit hit by 1 or more of this model's Indirect Fire weapon attacks

effects.trigger: one of those Indirect Fire attacks destroys an enemy model with Deadly Demise
